data.narrative:
Hyfix is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Mike Horton and Udan Ercan that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies across the sector—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $15M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to next stage, implying $38M. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, NODA AI at $125M Series A) yields a median of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The divergence between methods reflects wide valuation dispersion in early-stage Defense & Security, where stage and specific capability mix drive substantial variance.

Triangulation across both methods supports a range of $32M (floor, conservative stage-progression), $219M (median), and $460M (ceiling, peer-median influenced). Key uncertainties include Hyfix's specific technical differentiation relative to the peer set, revenue traction or customer validation not reflected in the data, and capital efficiency relative to better-capitalized competitors. Resolution of these factors will materially narrow the range as the company approaches next funding.
